priorityList: Maintain poisons and always enter combat from Stealth.
Cast Shadow Blades when both Shadow Dance and Secret Technique are ready to be used.
Activate Shadow Dance when not in stealth, provided Secret Technique is ready or Darkest Night is active.
Use Vanish when not in stealth and at 1 or fewer combo points to reset stealth-based buffs.
Use Secret Technique as your highest priority finisher, especially during Shadow Dance.
Use Eviscerate as a finisher whenever the Darkest Night buff is active.
Cast Coup de Grace as a finisher if Secret Technique is on cooldown or Shadow Dance is active.
Cast Black Powder as a finisher when facing 3 or more targets (unless Darkest Night or Coup de Grace takes priority).
Use Eviscerate as a finisher when facing fewer than 3 targets.
Use Shadowstrike to apply Deathstalker's Mark if it is missing from your target.
Use Shuriken Storm as your primary builder whenever there are 2 or more targets.
Use Shadowstrike instead of Shuriken Storm for priority damage or when facing 3 or fewer targets.
Use Goremaw's Bite if you have a combo point deficit of 3 or more.
Sync offensive trinkets, potions, and racial abilities with Shadow Blades and Shadow Dance windows.
Use Arcane Torrent if you are low on Energy to sustain your rotation.
